articles.title: Battery Energy Storage Systems Emerge as Key Enabler of India’s Energy and Mobility Transition
articles.description: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) are vital to India’s clean energy transition, stabilizing the grid to achieve 500 GW of renewable capacity by 2030–31.
